newsitem.title: USA: Myers sets 10 pct stock dividend.
newsitem.headline: Myers sets 10 pct stock dividend.

text.p: Myers Industries Inc said Thursday that its board of directors declared a 10 percent stock dividend to its shareholders of record on Aug 6. The stock distribution will occur on Aug 29.

The company, a diversified maker of polymer and metal products for industrial, commercial and consumer markets, as well as a nationwide wholesaler distributor of tire repair, and undercar service products, said it will keep its quarterly cash dividend payment at $0.05 per share after the stock dividend, for an effective 10 percent increase.
